rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when something is done with twice the usual degree or severity.

example.english: The wind is doubly strong today, so be careful when going out.
example.traditional: 今日啲風加倍咁勁，出街要小心。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 fung1 gaa1 bui3 gam3 ging6 ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this written-form equivalent when describing an especially intensified degree, such as being doubly careful.

example.english: We need to be doubly careful so we do not make another mistake.
example.traditional: 我哋要倍加小心，唔好再出錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bui3 gaa1 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceot1 co3

rows.note: Use this when something is true or wrong in both of two respects.

example.english: This plan is doubly flawed: it fails in both respects.
example.traditional: 呢個方案兩方面都唔掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 loeng5 fong1 min6 dou1 m4 dim6
